t: This is the Roman Catholic Church of St Thomas More, a Catholic church in Camden. It takes its name from Sir Thomas More, whom the Catholic Church venerates as a martyr and saint. In his lifetime he was a lawyer, judge and Renaissance humanist, and he served Henry VIII as Lord Chancellor from October 1529 to May 1532. He is also remembered for Utopia, published in 1516, which describes the political system of an imaginary island state.
